prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a realistic close-up portrait poster composed of two overlaid image layers. The first layer features a generic adult woman against a clean solid red background, photographed under hard direct sunlight while raising an open hand close to the camera. A single eyeglass lens frame is centered as a lens-window concept, precisely revealing the woman's face. Apply a frosted-glass effect to the second layer, while the area inside the eyeglass lens remains clearer. The adult woman has direct eye contact, a calm focused expression, natural makeup, blonde or platinum-blonde long layered hair with soft waves, realistic pores, a simple minimalist top, a small hoop earring and a thin ring. Use a tight 2:3 vertical close-up with the hand and head dominating the frame. Keep the base portrait sharp, apply global frosted-glass diffusion, blur and vintage grain outside the lens, and preserve clean high-contrast editorial typography in the poster layout.
